name: yaml-lite
description: Offline parser for a deliberate SUBSET of YAML (full YAML is a large, ambiguous spec and is explicitly out of scope). Supports nested block maps and lists by indentation, inline flow collections ([a, b] and {k: v}), scalars (strings, numbers, booleans, null, quoted strings with backslash escapes), comments, and multi-line block scalars (| literal and > folded). Refuses — with a clear error rather than a wrong-but-plausible parse — anything from full YAML that this subset does not implement: anchors/aliases (&name / *name), tags (!!type), multi-document streams (---), and merge keys (<<). Because anchors/aliases are refused outright, the 'billion laughs' exponential-expansion class of YAML attack is structurally impossible here, not just mitigated. Returns both the parsed data and a list of any non-fatal warnings (e.g. a bare tab used for indentation, which YAML forbids). Both block-indentation nesting and inline flow-collection nesting are capped at 500 levels; a deeper document gets a clean 'nesting too deep' error instead of overflowing the call stack.

text.description: The YAML-subset document text to parse.

data.description: The parsed value: an object, array, string, number, boolean, or null.
